title: Heavy Transport & Tractor Trucks
h1: Heavy Transport Truck Rental Saudi Arabia
shortSummary: GulfFast supplies heavy-duty tractor trucks and transport head units across Saudi Arabia, supporting long-haul logistics and site heavy haulage. Operating from Al Khobar, our Mercedes Actros, Volvo FH, and MAN fleets are equipped with Aramco gate passes and certified drivers.
description:
GulfFast Heavy Vehicle Rentals delivers heavy-duty tractor trucks and prime movers for industrial haulage across Saudi Arabia. Serving oilfield logistics contractors, EPC project managers, and heavy freight haulers, our heavy transport fleet handles demanding highway haulage and rugged desert site transit.

Our fleet comprises 4x2, 6x4, and 6x6 heavy tractor trucks manufactured by Mercedes-Benz (Actros series), Volvo Trucks (FH/FMX), and MAN. Every truck is equipped with GPS fleet tracking, IVMS (In-Vehicle Monitoring Systems), emergency cutoff switches, and site safety kits required for entry into Saudi Aramco, SABIC, and SEC industrial zones.

Whether you need monthly tractor truck rental with SAG-licensed professional drivers or bare-lease prime movers for fleet expansion, GulfFast provides direct-supplier vehicle rentals backed by 24/7 mobile mechanic support.

faq.question: Are your heavy transport trucks equipped with IVMS tracking for Aramco sites?
faq.answer: Yes. All GulfFast heavy transport trucks feature approved IVMS (In-Vehicle Monitoring System) devices and speed governors compliant with Saudi Aramco and SABIC transport safety manuals.

faq.question: Can I rent tractor trucks with professional heavy transport drivers?
faq.answer: Yes, we provide option for fully driven rentals with experienced, SAG-licensed heavy transport drivers holding valid Aramco driver safety certifications.

faq.question: What trailer types can be coupled with your prime movers?
faq.answer: Our tractor trucks fit standard kingpin sizes for flatbed trailers, lowbed heavy haulers, fuel tankers, water tankers, and skeletal container chassis.

title: Flatbed Trailers & Cargo Haulers
shortSummary: GulfFast offers 40ft and 50ft flatbed trailer rentals across Saudi Arabia, hauling steel structural members, pipes, containers, and general cargo. Based in Al Khobar, our trailers are engineered with heavy-duty drop sides and container locks.
description:
Flatbed trailers remain the backbone of industrial cargo movement throughout the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. GulfFast Trailer Rentals supplies heavy-duty multi-axle flatbed trailers built to withstand high payloads and severe road conditions in urban and desert environments.

Our trailer fleet includes 12-meter (40ft) and 15-meter (50ft) tri-axle flatbed trailers with high-tensile steel main beams, heavy wooden or diamond-plate steel flooring, removable drop sides, twist locks for ISO shipping containers, and heavy lashing winches for secure cargo tying.

All trailers undergo regular brake, tire, and suspension safety inspections, ensuring full compliance with Saudi Ministry of Transport (MOT) regulations and Aramco site safety requirements.

faq.question: Do your flatbeds have twist locks for 20ft and 40ft containers?
faq.answer: Yes, all our flatbed trailers are equipped with heavy twist-lock assemblies designed to safely lock down standard 20ft and 40ft ISO shipping containers.

faq.question: What is the maximum payload capacity of your tri-axle flatbeds?
faq.answer: Our heavy-duty tri-axle flatbeds carry certified payload capacities up to 50 Metric Tons, compliant with KSA axle weight standards.

faq.question: Can flatbeds be rented on long-term bare leases?
faq.answer: Yes, we offer flexible long-term monthly and annual bare trailer leases for transport fleets operating across Saudi Arabia.

title: Lowbed Trailers & Heavy Machinery Haulers
shortSummary: GulfFast supplies heavy-duty lowbed trailers and extendable low-loaders across Saudi Arabia for transporting bulldozers, excavators, transformers, and oversized machinery. Based in Al Khobar, our lowbed fleet handles up to 100-ton super loads.
description:
Moving heavy tracked earthmoving machinery and high-tonnage industrial equipment requires low deck heights and high axle loading capabilities. GulfFast Lowbed Rentals supplies multi-axle heavy haulage lowbed trailers designed for safe equipment loading and highway transport across KSA.

Our lowbed lineup ranges from standard 50-ton heavy lowbeds up to 100-ton multi-axle extendable low-loaders and drop-deck trailers with hydraulic ramps. Featuring low ground clearance for overhead bridge clearance and wide outriggers for wide-track dozers, these units ensure safe transportation of high-value machinery.

We provide complete heavy transport logistics support including escort vehicle planning, ministry overload permits, and Aramco transport clearance.

faq.question: Can GulfFast handle highway permits for oversized heavy equipment haulage?
faq.answer: Yes. Our logistics team handles Ministry of Transport overload permits and police/pilot escort coordination for over-dimensional heavy loads.

faq.question: What is the lowest deck height available for tall equipment transportation?
faq.answer: We offer drop-deck lowbeds with deck heights as low as 0.8 meters to pass under highway power lines and overpass bridges safely.

faq.question: Do lowbed trailers come with hydraulic loading ramps for tracked dozers?
faq.answer: Yes, our lowbeds feature heavy-duty spring-assisted or hydraulic ramps lined with timber inserts to prevent steel track slipping.

title: Fuel & Water Tanker Trucks
shortSummary: GulfFast supplies diesel fuel tanker trucks, potable water tankers, and brackish water tankers for rental across Saudi Arabia. Headquartered in Al Khobar, our fleet services construction camps, oilfield drill rigs, and dust suppression operations.
description:
Reliable fuel and water logistics are vital for remote construction projects and desert oilfield camps. GulfFast Tanker Truck Rentals provides certified liquid transport tankers equipped with high-flow pumps, digital meters, and safety containment features across KSA.

Our tanker fleet includes diesel fuel tankers (10,000 to 32,000 liters) with calibrated flow meters and safety discharge nozzles for site generator refueling, food-grade stainless steel potable water tankers for worker accommodation camps, and heavy steel brackish water tankers (4,000 to 8,000 gallons) fitted with rear water spray bars for earthwork dust suppression.

All fuel and water tankers carry Civil Defense certificates, Saudi Aramco site approval stickers, and are operated by trained drivers skilled in hazardous liquid handling.

description:
Safe, reliable daily transport of workforce personnel between accommodation camps and job sites is essential for project productivity. GulfFast Crew Transport Rentals supplies modern air-conditioned passenger buses and minivans tailored for Saudi Arabia's high ambient temperatures.

Our passenger fleet includes 15-seater Toyota HiAce vans, 30-seater Toyota Coaster / Mitsubishi Fuso buses, and 50-seater luxury coach buses (Daewoo, Hyundai, King Long). Every vehicle is equipped with dual high-capacity roof AC units, individual seat belts, fire extinguishers, first aid kits, emergency window hammers, and IVMS tracking.

GulfFast provides long-term daily crew transport contracts with experienced SAG-licensed drivers as well as bare vehicle leases for contractor site management.
